result.Method of Attack: Phishing attacks on popular maintainers leading to package compromises
result.Impacted Systems: JavaScript ecosystem projects using affected npm packages
result.Attack Vector: Phishing to gain maintainer account access
result.Indicators of Compromise: Compromised maintainer accounts of qix and DuckDB; 2-3 billion downloads per week of affected packages; Ethereum theft (~$500) and other cryptos (~$50) from compromised packages
